Minor mismatches remain because the prompt simplifies the real library to double-precision and a smaller feature surface, while the actual implementation also supports additional compile-time type modes and broader parser capabilities.
reasons.testability: This prompt is highly testable because it names the exact include path, required public API, observable success/error signals, comment stripping behavior, separator setters/getters, live pointer binding semantics, and concrete evaluation examples that align closely with the blackbox tests. A few implementation-adjacent behaviors are still unstated, but the prompt is sufficient to drive a blackbox-verifiable implementation of the required core behavior.
